status: experimental assurance architecture; no capability promotion
purpose: Replace over-reliance on one-dimensional A0-A4 summaries with a compositional, deny-dominant assurance vector while preserving A0-A4 as a compatibility rendering where useful.

semantics.required_assurance: The minimum evidence/verification obligations demanded by all applicable local and domain floors for this action.
semantics.attempted_assurance: The mechanisms actually invoked in an effort to satisfy required assurance.
semantics.achieved_assurance: Requirements for which sufficient evidence was successfully produced and remains current.
semantics.failed_assurance: Requirements that were attempted but demonstrably did not satisfy their acceptance criteria.
semantics.unknown_assurance: Requirements whose state cannot currently be established because evidence is missing, stale, unavailable, contradictory, or unverifiable.

composition.compatibility_summary: A0-A4 may be derived only as a lossy summary and must not be used to infer missing dimensions.
composition.required_floor_rule: For each dimension, compose all applicable non-waivable floors by taking the strongest requirement for that dimension.
composition.deny_dominant_rule: A consequential action is assurance-satisfied only if every required dimension is achieved. Failed or unknown required dimensions deny or hold according to explicit degraded-mode policy.
composition.no_compensation_rule: Strength in one dimension cannot compensate for failure in another unless a specific policy explicitly defines a safe substitution and evidence for it.

compatibility_mapping.note: Collective finality is not itself an assurance dimension and remains a separate finality concept.

invariants: assurance is not a global person reputation score
unknown is not equivalent to failed, but both fail a required consequential assurance gate unless degraded-mode policy explicitly permits holding or advisory use
later stronger verification never rewrites assurance_at_execution
compatibility rendering cannot silently upgrade a vector
non-waivable kernel floors cannot be lowered by imported domain policy
nonclaims: This profile does not promote adaptive assurance as a current production capability.
A0-A4 remain current compatibility identifiers where already implemented; this profile does not silently change existing runtime behavior.
This profile does not define collective finality or consensus.
This profile does not authorize any action.
